title: Directory listing enabled
description: The response is an automatic index page (an automatic index page). Anyone can browse file names in that directory, which can expose backups, source, or unlinked files.
remediation: Disable automatic indexes (autoindex off (nginx) or Options -Indexes (Apache)) and remove stray backup or source files from the web root.
limitation: Title marker on one body: a page that quotes an index title can match.
